LanguageData.SW_AcidSpew.label: acid spew
LanguageData.SW_AcidSpew.description: Command the creature to spray an acidic at a target. Once trained, the creature will spew acid on command.
LanguageData.SW_Calamity.label: calamity
LanguageData.SW_Calamity.description: Command the creature to emit a beastly roar to create calamity and fear in nearby enemies.
LanguageData.SW_ForceChaosSkip.label: force chaos skip
LanguageData.SW_ForceChaosSkip.description: Command the creature to teleport an object via the another reality to a random location nearby.
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.label: force focus
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.description: Command the creature use it's innate connection to the Force to heighten it's own or anothers senses.
LanguageData.SW_ForceInvisibility.label: force invisibility
LanguageData.SW_ForceInvisibility.description: Command the creature to harness their innate force connection turn themselves invisible for a short time.
LanguageData.SW_ForcePush.label: force push
LanguageData.SW_ForcePush.description: Command the creature to shoot a force energy blast at a target.
LanguageData.SW_ForceScream.label: force scream
LanguageData.SW_ForceScream.description: Command the creature to emit a force amplified scream to create a sense of fear in nearby enemies.
LanguageData.SW_GoldForage.label: gold forage
LanguageData.SW_GoldForage.description: Command the creature to sniff out a small quanity of gold hidden near the surface.
LanguageData.SW_Leap.label: animal leap
LanguageData.SW_Leap.description: Command the creature to jump to a distant location using strong hind legs.
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.label: rampage
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.description: Command the creature to go into a heightened physical state.
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.label: soothe song
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.description: Command the creature to emit a soothing song to calm nearby colonists.
LanguageData.SW_Spit.label: spit
LanguageData.SW_Spit.description: Command the creature to spit a glob of saliva at a target.
LanguageData.SW_Spur.label: spur
LanguageData.SW_Spur.description: Command the creature to go into a heightened physical state making it move faster for a while.
LanguageData.SW_SwarmCall.label: swarm call
LanguageData.SW_SwarmCall.description: Command the creature to emit a swarm call that turns a single target manhunter.
LanguageData.SW_ToxicSpew.label: defensive vomiting
LanguageData.SW_ToxicSpew.description: Command the creature to vomit a toxic gas bolus on an area.
LanguageData.SW_WebShot.label: web shot
LanguageData.SW_WebShot.description: Command the creature to shoot a blob of hardened silk webbing at a target.
